page.overview:
What is Golden-Nosed White-Haired Mouse Spirit?

The Golden-Nosed White-Haired Mouse Spirit (Chinese: 金鼻白毛老鼠精; pinyin: Jīnbí Báimáo Lǎoshǔ Jīng), also known as Lady Earth Flow (地涌夫人) and Half-Guanyin (半截观音), is a yaoguai in the 16th-century Chinese novel Journey to the West (西游记).

Appearing in the novel, she attempts to seduce and marry the monk Tang Sanzang to consume his yang essence. The spirit has a connection with Heavenly King Li Jing, whom she identifies as her godfather, and with Nezha, whom she identifies as her godbrother.
